svg.title: ST185 OEM junction - IE1 cowl plug - left kick panel
svg.text: IE1 COWL PLUG - LEFT KICK PANEL
Engine-room <-> cowl plug at the left kick panel. The engine-room main is REMOVED (R12); we splice into the factory cowl-side lead of each pin we use (EWD 1993 p.31, p.116-117, p.130, p.148, p.185).
headlight relay coil- line: splice I2 -> light control SW C15-14 HEAD / C15-13 FLASH to ground (also
crimp butt splice into the factory cowl-side lead (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> Headlight coil splice - HEAD LH and RH relay coils to cowl plug IE1 pin 2
30A RTR -> retract control relay R8 pin 3 (OEM relay stays)
heavy crimp butt splice into the factory cowl-side lead (cabin side; engine-room main
-> POWER box AMI OUT pin 2 (glove box; CabinPower) - RTR 30 A fuse out
wiper switch C16-4 (park S) <- F9 pin 3
crimp butt splice into the factory cowl-side lead (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> Front wiper motor F9 pin 3 (cowl, driver side) - park switch S (EWD p.148)
retract control relay R8-4 -> retract motor RH R3 pin 4
crimp butt splice into the factory cowl-side lead (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> RH retract motor feed - 12 AWG to 16 AWG pigtail, at R3
retract control relay R8-5 -> retract motor RH R3 pin 2
crimp butt splice into the factory cowl-side lead (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> RH retract motor R3 pin 2 - motor feed from IE1 pin 8 (EWD p.117)
retract control relay R8-11 (DOWN / close limit) <- R2 / R3 pin 3
crimp butt splice into the factory cowl-side lead (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> Retract close-limit join - R2 + R3 pin 3 to IE1 pin 9
heavy crimp butt splice into the factory lead
-> POWER box AMI OUT pin 3 (glove box; CabinPower) - AM1 40 A fuse out
headlight high-beam return (C15-3 dimmer / flash, high-beam indicator) <- H1 / H2 pin 1
crimp butt splice into the factory cowl-side lead (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> High-beam return join - H1 + H2 pin 1 to IE1 pin 11
HAZ-HORN feed -> hazard switch / turn flasher
crimp butt splice into the factory cowl-side lead (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> Hazard splice after LOGIC Bus 1 pin 4 (glove box; CabinPower) - HAZ-HORN 15 A
wiper switch C16-7 (LOW / INT / MIST) -> F9 pin 2
crimp butt splice into the factory cowl-side lead (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> Front wiper motor F9 pin 2 (cowl, driver side) - LOW (EWD p.148)
retract control relay R8-1 -> retract motor LH R2 pin 4
crimp butt splice into the factory cowl-side lead (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> LH retract motor feed - 12 AWG to 16 AWG pigtail, at R2
retract control relay R8-2 -> retract motor LH R2 pin 2
crimp butt splice into the factory cowl-side lead (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> LH retract motor R2 pin 2 - motor feed from IE1 pin 15 (EWD p.117)
retract control relay R8-7 (UP / open limit) <- R2 / R3 pin 1
crimp butt splice into the factory cowl-side lead (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> Retract open-limit join - R2 + R3 pin 1 to IE1 pin 16
heavy crimp butt splice into the factory lead
-> POWER box AMI OUT pin 4 (glove box; CabinPower) - AM2 30 A fuse out
headlight low-beam return (C15-12 dimmer side) <- H1 / H2 pin 2
crimp butt splice into the factory cowl-side lead (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> Low-beam return join - H1 + H2 pin 2 to IE1 pin 18
horn relay coil- line: horn SW C15-10 to ground <- k_horn 85
crimp butt splice into the factory cowl-side lead (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> Horn Relay (seated in the LOGIC box M3) pin 85
crimp butt splice into the factory cowl-side lead (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> Front wiper motor F9 pin 1 (cowl, driver side) - HIGH (EWD p.148)
OEM box: only the plugs / cavities we splice are drawn
Generated by docs/build/wiring-diagrams/build_wiring_diagrams.py from docs/harness/interfaces.json (flyingLeads); wire facts from the looms. Every cavity not shown stays factory.
Splice dot = our wire butt-spliced into the factory lead. Wire label: wire id | gauge | insulation colour (ident bands). Far end: DECISIONS R156 form.
